info.name: SMS OTP Country Restriction
info.description:
smsOtpAllowedCountryCodes on RiderConfig / TransporterConfig.

Rolls the config out to [+91] through the dashboard dynamic-logic APIs, checks that /auth rejects an SMS OTP to another country code (and never falls back to WhatsApp), that WhatsApp still works, then restores the rollout.

Resend goes through sendOTP even in local dev, so it is asserted too (the SMS itself lands on the mock server).

exec: // Generate random numbers ONCE per collection run
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('_test_in_rider')) {
var n = function (first) { return first + Math.floor(100000000 + Math.random() * 899999999); };
['_test_in_rider'].forEach(function (k) { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, n('8')); });
['_test_in_driver', '_test_in_driver_alt'].forEach(function (k) { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, n('9')); });

['_test_us_rider_base', '_test_us_rider', '_test_us_rider_profile', '_test_us_driver_base', '_test_us_driver', '_test_us_driver_profile', '_test_us_driver_alt'].forEach(function (k) { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, n('2')); });
var d = null; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}

var isTest = function (x) { return (x.versionDescription || '').indexOf('Integration test SMS OTP country restriction') === 0; };
var domain = {"tag": "RIDER_CONFIG", "contents": "RiderConfig"};

var live = (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []).map(function (r) { return {domain: r.domain, timeBounds: r.timeBounds, rollout: (r.rollout || []).filter(function (x) { return !isTest(x); }).map(function (x) { return {rolloutPercentage: x.rolloutPercentage, version: x.version, versionDescription: x.versionDescription || 'restored'}; })}; });
var restore = live.length > 0 ? live : [{domain: domain, timeBounds: 'Unbounded', rollout: []}];
// A failed read must not produce a snapshot: restoring from it would wipe live rollouts.

if (pm.response.code === 200 && Array.isArray(d)) { pm.environment.set('_sms_rider_rollout_snapshot', JSON.stringify(restore)); console.log('RiderConfig rollout snapshot:', JSON.stringify(restore)); }
var d = null; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('TransporterConfig rollout read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Array.isArray(d), 'response is a JSON array').to.eql(true); });
var isTest = function (x) { return (x.versionDescription || '').indexOf('Integration test SMS OTP country restriction') === 0; };

var live = (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []).map(function (r) { return {domain: r.domain, timeBounds: r.timeBounds, rollout: (r.rollout || []).filter(function (x) { return !isTest(x); }).map(function (x) { return {rolloutPercentage: x.rolloutPercentage, version: x.version, versionDescription: x.versionDescription || 'restored'}; })}; });
var restore = live.length > 0 ? live : [{domain: domain, timeBounds: 'Unbounded', rollout: []}];
// A failed read must not produce a snapshot: restoring from it would wipe live rollouts.

if (pm.response.code === 200 && Array.isArray(d)) { pm.environment.set('_sms_driver_rollout_snapshot', JSON.stringify(restore)); console.log('TransporterConfig rollout snapshot:', JSON.stringify(restore)); }
pm.test('RiderConfig rollout restored', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('TransporterConfig rollout restored', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Rider resend of the +1 WhatsApp OTP after the rejected SMS attempts (still WhatsApp, allowed)

exec: var d = {}; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}

pm.test('Rider +1 WhatsApp resend -> not rejected by the country restriction', function () { pm.expect(d.errorMessage || '').to.not.include('SMS OTP is not supported for this mobile country code'); });
pm.test('Rider +1 WhatsApp resend -> 200, or the local OTP provider failure (500 INTERNAL_ERROR)', function () {
if (pm.response.code === 200) { return; }
pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(500);
pm.expect(d.errorCode).to.eql('INTERNAL_ERROR');
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { console.log('Rider +1 WhatsApp resend: OTP provider call failed locally (' + pm.response.code + ' ' + (d.errorCode || '') + '), after passing the country check'); }
var d = {}; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('Rider +91 resend -> 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
